summary: Tested new features: Opening Quiz Mode and In-Game Memory Integration. Found and fixed a bug in OpeningQuiz.jsx where API URLs were double-prefixed with /api. Created 16 backend tests (all passing) and 10 frontend E2E tests (all passing). Quiz API returns proper question types (concept, position, move_order) and scoring works correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Opening Quiz Mode is fully tested and working. Quiz API at /api/training/openings/{key}/quiz returns questions with concept, position, move_order types. Submit endpoint at POST /api/training/openings/{key}/quiz/submit scores answers and updates user_opening_progress collection. Fixed bug in OpeningQuiz.jsx - API URLs were double-prefixed with /api. Memory fields (memory_insight, pattern_connection, focus_note, games_together) are correctly defined in HumanCoachService and stored in coach_messages collection when Socratic dialogue triggers.
